description: This file defines the LabelUtils class, a utility class that provides message retrieval methods using Spring's ApplicationContext to access message resources based on keys and locale information.

classes.name: LabelUtils
classes.description: A utility class for retrieving localized messages from the application's message source, implementing ApplicationContextAware to gain access to the Spring application context.

methods.name: setApplicationContext
methods.description: Sets the Spring application context, allowing the class to access message resources.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the message associated with the given key and locale.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the message associated with the key and locale, returning a default value if not found.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a formatted message for the given key, arguments, and locale.
